title: Regular local fibre finrank dimension comparison
statement: For a finite type algebra over a field and a prime with separable residue field, the localization is regular local if and only if the finrank of the residue-field fibre of Kähler differentials equals the topological Krull dimension at the prime.

proof.text: Finite type makes S Noetherian. Obtain finite natural-number dimensions d and r and point dimension d+r from the existing dimension-at-point theorem.

Rewrite regularity with the Mathlib cotangent criterion and rewrite the differential fibre finrank with the additive formula. Injectivity of natural-number casts and cancellation of r identify both equalities.
